verdict.rationale: Mercury documents savings accounts, yield of up to 3.89% through Treasury, and an internal-transfer API between checking, savings and treasury accounts. A long-time customer reports running purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules, which suggests recurring automated transfers exist. However, no first-party documentation describes automated transfer rules or confirms the savings sub-account itself earns high yield; the yield is tied to the Treasury advisory product. Missing for 10: first-party docs for recurring or rule-based auto-transfer configuration, evidence that the savings account itself is high-yield, independent corroboration beyond a single community comment.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can build a cash cushion in a high-yield savings sub-account with automated transfer rules

citations.quote: Apply for free checking and savings accounts with zero minimums, earn up to 3.89% yield with Treasury by Mercury Advisory
Supports transfers between depository accounts (checking/savings), from a depository account to a treasury/investment account, and from a treasury/investment account to a depository account.
dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules
